text:
𝗜𝗡𝗗𝗜𝗔 𝗪𝗜𝗡 𝗢𝗡 𝗧𝗛𝗘 𝗟𝗔𝗦𝗧 𝗕𝗔𝗟𝗟! 🇮🇳🔥

India U19 chased 338 v Pakistan in the Asia Cup final: 339/9, won by 1 wicket.
Mohit Ulva 49* off 26 hit the winning boundary. 9th title.

What a final 👏

#U19AsiaCup #INDvPAK

facebook.caption:
𝗟𝗔𝗦𝗧 𝗕𝗔𝗟𝗟 𝗣𝗘 𝗜𝗡𝗗𝗜𝗔 𝗖𝗛𝗔𝗠𝗣𝗜𝗢𝗡! 🇮🇳🔥

👉 Pakistan U19 ne banaye 337/9, India ko chahiye the 338
👉 Mohit Ulva ne 26 gend mein 49* thoka, last ball pe boundary se jeet
👉 India ne 1 wicket se final jeeta, 9th U19 Asia Cup title
👉 Captain Raichandani 80, Kavya Patel 4/68

Kya ye sabse zabardast U19 final tha? Comment karo 👇
